**DI63** is a medical diagnosis code representing cerebral infarction (*hjerneinfarkt*) [^src1]. Within the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality databases, specifically the registry for [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation), DI63 is a fundamental component used to monitor treatment safety and patient outcomes [^src1]. It serves as the primary identifier for [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke), which is tracked as a critical safety indicator reflecting potentially insufficient anticoagulation therapy [^src3].

To calculate the incidence of ischemic stroke, data is extracted from the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] (Danish National Patient Register) using DI63 as an action diagnosis [^src4]. The methodology also accounts for patients who might initially be registered for rehabilitation; therefore, DI63 is additionally captured as a secondary diagnosis when it appears in combination with the action diagnosis [[dz501|DZ501]] (contact for other physical therapy) [^src2]. Together with [[di64|DI64]] (stroke without specification of hemorrhage or infarction), DI63 forms the complete diagnostic criteria for measuring stroke incidence in this patient population [^src1].

## Claims
- **diagnostic**: For incidens af iskæmisk apopleksi anvendes diagnoserne DI63 (hjerneinfarkt), DI64 (slagtilfælde uden oplysning om blødning eller infarkt) og DZ501 (Kontakt mhp. anden fysioterapi) i kombination med DI63 eller DI64 [^src1] (di63, di64, dz501) (Page 118) [^src1]
